text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho (Spring)—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Due to renovations at Kyoto Racecourse, 
this year's 3,200m turf GⅠ is being held 
at Hanshin Racecourse. The pinnacle battle 
for stayers in spring."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"In this race, a Tiara Umamusume has 
achieved victory only once. In the past 
several decades, none have even made it 
onto the board."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Amidst all this, multiple Tiara Umamusume 
are slated to enter the race this year."

text_block_list.name: Race-Loving Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I'm really looking forward to it! 
The Tiara route was extremely exciting 
last year, but..."

text_block_list.name: Race-Loving Celebrity
text_block_list.text:
"It's as if that frenzy is still going on 
today! Among the contenders is Curren 
Bouquetd'or, who made her mark on the 
Tiara route!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Her performance in the Nikkei Sho was 
truly magnificent. Will her stamina shine 
through in the Tenno Sho (Spring) as 
well...?!"

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Will this mark a brand new page in 
history— The Tenno Sho (Spring) is finally 
underway!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "...―― It's about time, isn't it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The heat of the buzzing crowd felt far 
away, leaving the paddock tunnel unusually 
quiet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At last—the day has come. The "Tenno Sho 
(Spring)"... The day of the decisive 
battle.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Before we go, may I ask one thing?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —In Chile, I saw a truly beautiful light.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: In the vast blue sky, a solitary sun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Though the wind was raging, it was warm 
and soft—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...The sun... so blinding—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I remembered that day... when my heart 
caught fire.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Your warmth... has once again solidified 
my resolve."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes sparkled quietly— yet burned with 
a blazing fire.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Would you... please watch me closely?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely see this through. I 
swear I will dedicate it all to you."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "A special, radiant bloom worthy of you—!"
